DESIGN_AND_TEST_BATCH.purpose: Design and test a fixed batch of up to 5 new development-only hypotheses.

DIAGNOSTIC.purpose: Diagnose a saved result or pipeline failure without retuning.

AUDIT.purpose: Audit state, registries, files, or reproducibility deterministically.

STOP.purpose: Stop automation and request human review.

hard_blocks: arbitrary shell command execution from task JSON
more than 5 new hypotheses per batch
uploading raw market data or proprietary strategy details to public GitHub
execution_rule: Local OpenClaw may map each allowed task_type to a fixed handler. Unknown task_type must be rejected.
